title: Optimist 30A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched along the coveted 30A corridor, The Optimist 30A defines elevated coastal living with three levels of beautifully designed space and sweeping Gulf views from its stunning rooftop sun deck. This seven-bedroom, seven-and-a-half-bath retreat blends refined luxury with effortless comfort, featuring sunlit porches, a private elevator, and thoughtfully curated interiors with serene textures, shiplap accents, and designer lighting. The open-concept main level centers around an elegant living area with a modern fireplace and a chef’s kitchen outfitted with a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf dual-fuel gas range, marble waterfall island, wine cooler, and coffee station—creating the perfect setting for gathering and entertaining. Outdoor living takes center stage with a resort-style heated pool, hot tub, waterfall feature, and a unique swim-up bar connected to a sunken outdoor kitchen complete with grill, Big Green Egg, ice maker, and soda cooler. Guests can unwind by the fire pit after sunset or take a short stroll to the nearby beach access for a day along the Gulf. With multiple king suites, a cheerful bunk room, a family lounge with a sleeper sofa, and a private carriage house guest suite, the home offers both privacy and space for larger groups. Added luxuries like a Peloton bike, six adult bikes, and a six-seat golf cart make exploring the charm, dining, and shopping of 30A both effortless and unforgettable.
